import pandas as pd

# Connect to the SQLite database

conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# Profile the customer360__customer_value_analysis table

# 2. Get table schema

print(f"Table Name: customer360__customer_value_analysis")

print(f"Total Columns: {len(schema_df)}")
print("\nColumn Information:")
print(schema_df[['name', 'type', 'notnull']].to_string(index=False))

# Close the connection
conn.close()
